Best Jumbo Pencils for Preschoolers: Big Grip, Easy Start for Little Hands – Best Toy Reviewed

# Best Jumbo Pencils for Preschoolers: Big Grip, Easy Start for Little Hands

 January 28, 2026 

Choosing jumbo pencils helps early writers build confidence with a comfortable grip and bold strokes. This guide highlights five top options designed for preschoolers and kindergartners, balancing grip, durability, and ease of use. Each pick features thick bodies, pre-sharpened or easily sharpened leads, and kid-friendly designs to support fine motor skills as young learners begin writing and drawing.

| Product | Brand | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mr. Pen – Jumbo Pencils for Preschoolers (10 + Sharpener) | Mr. Pen | Great starter set with extra sharpener |
| Channie’s My First Pencil (2 Pack) | Channie’s | Easy-to-hold 4.7″ pencils with bulky erasers |
| Mr. Pen – Jumbo Pencils (30 Pencil Pack) | Mr. Pen | Colorful barrels, versatile for various projects |
| Enday Jumbo Pencils For Preschoolers (24 Pack) | Emraw | Pre-sharpened convenience with thick lead |
| Shuttle Art Jumbo Pencils (18 Pack) | Shuttle Art | Triangular shape with top erasers |

## Mr. Pen Jumbo Pencils for Preschoolers, 10 Big Pencils and 1 Sharpener

These jumbo pencils are designed for beginners and early writers. The package includes ten large pencils and a dedicated sharpener, supporting steady practice for small hands. The wood is described as high quality for easier sharpening, and the large 0.38″ diameter is ideal for children developing grip strength and control. The set’s straightforward design makes it a reliable first step for color exploration and handwriting activities in preschool and kindergarten settings.

## Channie’s My First Pencil, Easy-to-Hold Jumbo Pencils

Channie’s offers a kid-friendly 2-pack of jumbo pencils aimed at ages 3-7. Each pencil measures about 4.7 inches long with a 0.5-inch diameter, designed to stay firmly in little fingers and deliver bold, dark lines with a 2B core. The set includes bulky erasers and comes pre-sharpened, making it ready for immediate classroom or home use. The ergonomic barrel promotes a comfortable grip, reducing fatigue during longer writing sessions and drawing activities.

## Mr. Pen Jumbo Pencils, 30 Pencil Pack

This larger set provides 30 jumbo pencils in five pastel barrel colors with black graphite cores. The extra-thick design offers a comfortable grip suitable for beginners and adults who favor a fuller writing sensation. Pencils arrive unsharpened to allow users to tailor the point to their needs, supporting a wide range of activities from precise drawing to broader shading as children grow more confident with writing tools.

## Enday Jumbo Pencils For Preschoolers (24 Pack)

Enday jumbo pencils are designed with little hands in mind, offering an ergonomic grip for effortless control. The thick 3.25 mm lead is break-resistant, suitable for toddlers and preschoolers developing handwriting skills. The pencils arrive pre-sharpened and ready for use, easing classroom setup and reducing prep time for teachers and parents alike. The rounded design supports a comfortable grip during daily writing and drawing activities.

## Emraw Enday Jumbo Pencils For Preschoolers (8 Pack)

This Emraw 8-pack mirrors Enday’s design approach with a thick, pre-sharpened jumbo pencil that’s easy for kids to grip. Its ergonomic round form and robust lead support steady, dark strokes during early writing activities. The set includes an eraser-capable top and is ready to use, helping focus children on forming letters and simple shapes without frequent interruptions for sharpening.

## Shuttle Art Jumbo Pencils – 18 Pack

Shuttle Art’s 18-pack focuses on a triangle grip with a thick barrel, designed to guide early writers toward a proper hold. Each pencil is pre-sharpened and includes a soft eraser for quick corrections. The 7.6-inch length and 13/21 inch diameter provide a stable, comfortable feel for children in early writing stages, supporting daily practice at home or in classrooms.

## Shuttle Art Jumbo Pencils – 36 Pack

This 36-pack expands on the 18-pack with a larger quantity for classrooms or families with multiple young learners. The triangular shape facilitates a proper grip and reduces hand fatigue during long writing sessions. Pre-sharpened and topped with erasers, these pencils are ready for quick classroom use and independent practice.

## Fainne 48 Pcs Fat Pencils Jumbo Set

Fainne offers a large 48-piece set featuring fat pencils with erasers and multiple sharpeners. The 10 mm diameter and 7.5-inch length are tailored for easy grip and comfortable writing for beginners. The triangle shape and durable natural wood construction support consistent lines, while the included accessories reduce interruptions during learning activities.

### Buying Guide: Key Considerations For Jumbo Pencils

- Grip and diameter: Larger diameters (0.38–0.5 inches) help children with developing motor skills to maintain a stable grip and reduce fatigue during handwriting and drawing.
- Lead and durability: Thick, sturdy graphite or lead cores (2B to 2HB ranges) deliver bold lines with less pressure, which is important for young writers who apply light, uncertain strokes.
- Pre-sharpened vs. sharpenable: Pre-sharpened pencils are ready to use, saving prep time for classrooms. Unsharpened options allow customization of point length for specific tasks.
- Material and safety: Choose pencils made from smooth wood with rounded edges and non-toxic erasers. Durable construction minimizes breakage during enthusiastic practice.
- Ergonomic design: Triangle or fat cylindrical shapes guide proper finger placement and help children develop a comfortable grip. Some sets include erasers and sharpeners for added convenience.
- Quantity and value: Larger packs are cost-effective for classrooms or households with multiple learners. Consider sets that include a sharpener or extra accessories to maximize usefulness.
- Versatility: Look for pencils suitable for both writing and drawing to support literacy and early art development, enabling a seamless transition across activities.
- Ergonomic growth: As children grow, a slightly slimmer pencil may be needed. A mix of sizes can accommodate a gradual shift from jumbo to standard pencils.

I Tested Fat Pencils for Kindergarten and Here's Why They're a Game-Changer for Young Learners

# I Tested Fat Pencils for Kindergarten and Here’s Why They’re a Game-Changer for Young Learners

 By Emily Johnson And Her Team

As a kindergarten teacher, I have seen first-hand the importance of using the right tools in the classroom. And when it comes to writing, one of the most essential tools for young learners is a good pencil. However, not all pencils are created equal, especially when it comes to little hands just starting their writing journey. That’s where fat pencils for kindergarten come in – designed specifically for small hands and developing motor skills.
